answer: Each head locks a bridge bond and commits to the hash of its training seed; each epoch a beacon-signed zephyr picks one slice to open, and a raven compares opened slices across all heads. Clones cut from one checkpoint collide when their shared slice opens, and the raven forfeits every colliding bridge to the finder: k copies of one earner raise the expected bill as k², each added clone deepening its siblings' exposure. Escaping means retraining every seed fresh — one full training run per clone, losing the copied edge.
